processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Solution treated at 1000 °C for 10 min and water quenched; this is the initial state before aging at 500 °C.

structures.overall_structure: Austenitic matrix (TRIPLEX grade) with diffuse superlattice reflections corresponding to the formation of intragranular κ (j-) phases, distinguished in the TEM diffraction pattern of austenite at the initial state.

phases_present.morphology: Diffuse superlattice reflections; individual particles not resolvable as discrete particles in dark-field imaging at the initial state.

precipitates.distribution: intragranular; diffuse and not resolvable as discrete particles at the initial state

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Diffraction pattern of austenite in the [001] zone axis (labelled [100]γ in the figure); dark-field image using {100} superlattice reflections.
characterization_methods.purpose: Observe the evolution of intragranular κ-phase (j-phase) precipitation in austenite, starting from the initial state.
characterization_methods.key_findings: At the initial state, diffuse superlattice reflections corresponding to the formation of intragranular κ-phases are distinguished in the austenite diffraction pattern; individual particles cannot be resolved in dark-field imaging.

unmapped_findings: Fig. 8a caption groups the 'initial stage and 2 min aging' in one panel; the body text (b0046) distinguishes them: at the initial state diffuse superlattice reflections were already distinguished, whereas after 2 min of aging the κ superlattice reflections are still weak and diffuse.

The austenite grain-size/Hall–Petch study (grain sizes 1.65–40 µm; Hall–Petch coefficients 461 MPa µm^1/2 for yield strength and 351 MPa µm^1/2 for tensile strength) was performed on the same 28.8Mn-9.4Al-0.92C alloy but on samples with different thermal treatments, so those data are not assigned to this initial-state/as-quenched sample.
